title: Structured Moral Reasoning in Language Models: A Value-Grounded Evaluation Framework

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model predictions and reasoning on cross-cultural and pluralistic moral dilemma datasets (e.g., UniMoral, Value Kaleidoscope) to measure whether models default to dominant moral heuristics or if they can accurately reflect non-dominant values and pluralistic ethical frameworks.

Analyzing confusion matrices and class-level accuracy (e.g., 'Support' vs. 'Oppose' labels) to measure the models' statistical tendency to over-predict the majority class and rely on surface-level default heuristics when explicit reasoning scaffolds are absent.
